title: Character description (character.json)
description: Selects the GH3 rig profile of the character GLB: a fixed profile of the band library (format 1.0) or a profile of a character library (format 1.1). The profile also selects the band role.

animations.description: Format 1.1: an animation set of the character library that has the profile. Absent: the set of the profile.

hairMaterials.description: GLB material names whose triangles use sorted hair transparency.

highway.description: Package path of the highway image of the character (PNG; GH3 uses 512 x 1024). The player's highway uses it when the character plays the player's role, as GH3 create_guitarist does. Absent: the default highway.

attachments.description: Attachment slot to a library instrument ID (band/band.json member instrument). An absent slot uses the default. The instrument follows the band role that the character plays.
